propositions: Four guards in test_subcall_class_selection.py each call _run_request_sites() independently, causing the same whole-tree AST analysis of src/rebar to run four times per test session.

The _verdict function's parameter-provenance branch re-walks the entire src/rebar tree and re-parses every file once per RunRequest site, multiplying parse overhead within a single _run_request_sites invocation.

The AST analysis is a pure function of committed src/rebar source code; no test mutates the tree and the only autouse fixture patches llm_config._read_llm_file_table which the AST scan does not consult.

A session-scoped fixture and per-path parse memoization cache will ensure _run_request_sites runs once per process and each source file is parsed at most once, eliminating both layers of repetition while preserving all assertion semantics.
